_comment: Slot-fillable phrases per dim token in en + es. Each entry is either a plain string, a list of 3-5 interchangeable variants, or (for top-NPC PRESENCE tokens — Brennan, Helena Voss, the catering supervisor) a dict of voice-arc stages cold/warming/breaking/broken. The composer picks variants deterministically by hash(turn_idx, token_id). All variants must work in any place the original string worked. Voice: third-person past, methodical, cold, reconstructive — Obra Dinn cartouche cadence, 1961 diplomatic-file register.

en: The four languages of the reception ran on beneath the conversation.
